description: Dependency manifest for the ignite module -- what the environment must provide. Declaration only; never published. Schema: concepts/dependency-manifest.md (sd-graph show dependency-manifest). js-yaml is a REQUIRED LIBRARY the daemon require()s, not a binary -- it resolves into this folder's node_modules (not the workspace shared bin root, which serves binaries on PATH) and package-lock.json beside this file is KEPT and committed (`npm ci`, exact versions + integrity hashes, D28 / task 7.51 pinning) -- both LAWFUL under the record's element-kind split (`decisions.md#d-dependency-manifest-element-classes`). System tools npm cannot express are declared machine-readably in rbtv.system below AND stay in dependencies.txt beside this file, the human-readable inventory owner ruling D28 requires; both are updated in the SAME change as any dependency change. rbtv.install and rbtv.system commands run with cwd = this folder.
